parameters.citation: R. Ishikawa, Low-Field and High-Field Anisotropic Carrier Transport in SiC, PhD thesis, Kyoto University (2025)
parameters.validity: Recommended value: thesis Sec. 3.4.3 (p.74) averages the results for N_D below 1e16 cm^-3 (self-heating at higher doping) to 1.7e7 cm/s for BOTH directions. NOTE: Table 3.1 per-doping vsat (2e15: 1.7, 5e15: 1.9, 1e16: 1.6, 3e16: 1.2, all x1e7 cm/s, identical in both directions); 1.7 is the mean of the three values at N_D <= 1e16 (the 1e16 sample is included; the mean of the two samples strictly below 1e16 would be 1.8). SiC(11-20) n-type epilayers, four-terminal bridge structures, pulsed conductance (Ch. 3, Sec. 3.3.1 p.66); v = mu E/[1+(mu E/vsat)^alpha]^(1/alpha) (Eq. 3.3, p.74), mu from the low-field linear region (E <= 3e3 V/cm); measurement temperature of the drift-velocity data not stated in Ch. 3 (hence null); mobility used in the fit is the conductance mobility with the Hall electron density, so the thesis notes the velocities may include an overestimate from the Hall scattering factor (p.75-76)
parameters.name: vsat_n_par_c
